column18: Analytical energy model: SNN with T=5 needs average spike rate below 5.7% to beat capacity-matched QNN
CSNPC fraud detection: 90.8% recall at 5% FPR; lower energy per transaction than dense ANNs asserted, no figures
SNN remote sensing detector on Xilinx XC7VX690T FPGA: significantly lower power and latency, high accuracy (no figures)
Event-camera SNN flame detection claims higher accuracy and lower computational load vs traditional methods (type unstated); no figures
SDARNet PSNR 39.96 dB; theoretical energy efficiency over 56% above equivalent ANN PReNet; 4.3% less energy than SNN ESDNet
Scale-adaptive SNN spike sorter adds and removes active nodes online; accuracy comparable to benchmark methods; energy savings claimed, no figures
HDI-Former SNN branch comparable to same-architecture ANN with 10.57x (DSEC) and 11.46x (PKU-DAVIS-SOD) less energy
LTH tickets lose soft-error robustness; two LT variants improve robustness up to 10,000x with under 1% latency overhead
D-SNN ECG; L1 regularisation plus pruning lowers estimated energy to 1.91 uJ/inference at 98.23% accuracy (intra-patient multiclass)
SNN region proposal feeds ANN segmentation of railway defects; competitive accuracy, lower energy than existing approaches (no figures)
S2TE sparse training with scale-free topology and prune-regrow; competitive accuracy at 30% connectivity on CIFAR10, CIFAR100, DVS-CIFAR10
SAEN-BGS spiking autoencoder; ANN-to-SNN self-distillation claims decreased power with no figure or named comparator
SAH-NeRF hybrid improves three ANN-based NeRFs in view synthesis and reduces energy (no figures)
SCAF-Net CREMA-D 79.03% vs equivalent ANN 80.83%; spike rate 7.19%; theoretical energy about 71x lower than ANN
SCNNTraffic accuracy 98.65 (ISCX-VPN) and 92.51 (Non-VPN); fewer parameters and lower energy than existing methods, no figures
SConvNSys FPGA SCNN accelerator: 1.8 W, 73 frames/s on CIFAR-10, 15.23 GOPS/W; no ANN baseline
Spiking transformer with dilated window attention beats SOTA spiking transformers; no ANN comparison, no efficiency figures
SDP comparable to ANN counterparts; projected dynamic energy -80.36% on 45 nm hardware; fewer floating-point operations
PHEN-NoC: pruning unused connections gives estimated 15.2% lower static power; Zynq FPGA 1.352 W, 19.63% LUTs
ANN-to-SNN conversion (SRIF neuron, collaborative trim) for EEG motor imagery: ANN-comparable accuracy; energy and complexity advantages claimed, no figures
SenSNN 20.87% mIoU at 4.18 mJ vs MobileNetV2-UNet 20.83% at 16.9 mJ (about 4x lower estimated energy)
SHARP 28 nm spiking chip: peak 83.2 TOPS/W, 2.16x energy efficiency over SOTA 3D point cloud processors
Sigma-delta ANN-to-SNN conversion on Loihi 2 vs Jetson Xavier: significant gains in efficiency and latency (EDP), no figures
Memristor-crossbar SNN simulation framework with nonideality models; compares nonideality impact on trace-SNN vs ANN (accuracy), no energy comparison
Survey of SNN-ANN hybrid architectures for wireless edge efficiency-accuracy trade-off; no quantitative figures
